content: Qeeseta Halaqa Malkexeedeqe
Hessi Malkexeedeqey Saaleme kawonne Xoossa qeese; izikka Abrahaamey kawota oli xoonidi simmishin demmidi Abrahaame anjjides.
Abrahaameykka baas diza ubbaafe tammu kusheppe issi kushe izas immides. Koyro iza sunththaas birsheththi, «Xillo kawo» guussa. Kaallidi qasse, «Saaleme kawo» guussi, «Saroteththa kawo» guussa.

Izas aayakka, aawaykka woykko iza yeletaas zarkkeyka baa; izi ayde yelettidi ayde hayqqidaakko erettibeenna; izas doomeththinne wurseththi baa; gido attiin Xoossa naa mala mernaas izi qeese gididi dees.
Ane intte izi ay mala gitakko qopite, haray attoshin aawatas ubbaas koyroy Abrahaamey ba di7i ekkida ubbaafe tammaafe issaa kessi immides.
Isttas qeeseteththi imettida Lewe nayti istta ishati Abrahaame zereththata gidikkoka deraappe hessika ba ishatappe tammaafe issaa ekkana mala isttas wogan azazettides.
Hayssa ha addeza zereththi Lewe zereth gidenna; gido attiin izi Abrahaameppe tammaafe issaa ekkides; kase izas hidota qaalay imettida Abrahaame anjjides.
Bayray kaalo anjjizayssi woga.
Issi baggara tammaafe issaa ekkizayti hayqqizayta; hara baggara qasse tammaafe issaa ekkizaadey hayqqontta paxa diza mala izas markkattidaadey Malkexeedeqe.
Haray attoshin Leweykka Abrahaame baggara tammaafe issaa kessides gaanaas dandayettees.
Gaasoykka Malkexeedeqey Abrahaamera gaaggiza wode Lewey buro ba aawaa Abrahaameppe yelettibeenna.
Yesusi Malkexeedeqe Mala
Pacey baynda poloy beettidaynne wogay derezas imettiday Lewe qeeseteththaa mala gididaakko Aaroone mala gidontta Malkexeedeqe shuumeteththaa malay hara qeesey yaanaas aazas koshshidee?
Qeeseteththa zarkkey laamettiza wode wogaykka laamettanayssi attontta miishsha.
Hessi wurikka izas yootettida qeesey izi hara zereththa; iza zereththaafe oonikka yarshoson ooththi erizaadey baa.
Nu Goday Yuhuda baggafe yidayssi tuma; Musey qeeseta gishshas yootishe ha zereththaa gishshas yootidayssi issi miishshika deenna.
Malkexeedeqe malay hara qeesey dendiko nu kase yootida yo7oy daro qoncce gidenna.
Izi qeese gididay dhayontta de7o wolqqan attiin zereththafe yida wogaappe gidenna.
Izas, «Ne Malkexeedeqe shuumeteththaa mala mernaas qeese» gi markkattides.
Kase azazoy laafanne go7onttayssa gidida gishshas attides.
Wogay oonakka geeshshanaas dandayontta gishshas nuni Xoossa ach shiiqanaas izappe aadhdhiza hara hidotay nuus imettides.
Hessika caaqoy baynda hanibeenna; hankko qeese gididayti caaqoy bayndayta.
Izi gidikko qeeseteththaa caaqon ekkides.
Hessa mala caaqoppe dendidayssan Yesusi hessafe aadhdhiza caaqo qaalas waase gidides.
Kase qeeseti ba ooson sinththe gujjontta mala hayqoy istta diggida gishshas qooday isttas daro.
Yesusi gidikko mernaas dizaade gidida gishshas iza qeeseteththi shaarettontta qeeseteththa.
Hessa gishshas izi istta giigsana gaannatishe ubba wode hayqqontta paxa eqqi diza gishshas iza baggara Xoossaako yizayta ubbaa ashshanaas dandayees.
Hessa gishshas nuus koshshiza qeeseta halaqay hessa mala geeshshinne wosoy iza bolla baynda xillonne nagaranchchatappe shaakettidi salotappe bollara bonchchettida qeeseta halaqa.

Izi hankko qeeseta halaqata mala koyro ba nagaraa gishshas qasseka hankko dereza nagaraa gishshas gallas gallas yarsho shiishshanaas iza koshshenna; izi bana aaththi immida wode asa nagara gishshas issito sinththa baggassara yarsho wursi polides.
Wogay daaburanchcha asata qeesetas waanna halaqa histti shuumees. Wogappe kaallidi yida caaqo qaalay gidikko mernaas iza bolla wosoy baynda naaza shuumides.
